whatChanged: Checkout flow: totals the cart, logs, and charges the user.

inline.title: `cart.getTotal()` now returns a Promise and isn't awaited
inline.body: `getTotal` became async in this PR, so `total` is a Promise here. `total <= 0` is always false, which means an empty cart can check out.

summarized.title: `d` doesn't say what the date is for
summarized.body: `d` is only used as the checkout timestamp. A name like `checkedOutAt` makes the log line read on its own.
